fields.mechanism: Evaluation of the interaction between automatic braking control logic and forward collision warning to identify sensor or actuator faults causing unintended vehicle motion.
fields.intervention: Diagnose the Electronic Throttle Control (ETC) module and vehicle speed sensors for intermittent signal interference, simulating the Automatic Emergency Braking system's response to false object detection or signal jitter.
fields.expected_effect: Isolate the root cause of the spontaneous acceleration event (e.g., ETC mapping error, wiring short, or sensor glitch) without relying on standard DTC warning lights.
fields.falsification_test: Reproduce the failure by injecting simulated high-frequency noise into the VSS sensor signal and throttle position sensor signal; if spontaneous acceleration occurs without a DTC, the mechanism is confirmed.
fields.mechanism_source_span: Evaluation of the Automatic Emergency Braking and Forward Collision
